items.title: India’s Growth Story Remains Strong, Resilient and Trustworthy Amid Global Uncertainties: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Shri Piyush Goyal

items.summary: ​Shri Dilip Kumar, Secretary, Department of Land Resources (DoLR), Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India, visited Odisha to review the progress and ground-level implementation of the Watershed Development Component of Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana 2.0 (WDC-PMKSY 2.0) and the World Bank-assisted Rejuvenating Watersheds for Agricultural Resilience through Innovative…
items.title: Secretary, DoLR Reviews Implementation of WDC-PMKSY 2.0 and World Bank-Assisted REWARD Programme in Odisha

items.summary: The Dr. Ambedkar Foundation (DAF), an autonomous body under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India, is implementing the revised ‘Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme’ , providing financial assistance of up to ₹ 3.50 lakh to eligible patients belonging to the Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs) suffering from serious and life-threatening diseases.
items.title: Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme Provides Financial Assistance of up to ₹ 3.50 Lakh to SC and ST Patients for Treatment of Life-Threatening Diseases
